mapper.select: SELECT CA.USER_NO, SHOP_ID, SHOP_TYPE, TRIM(VENDOR_ID) AS VENDOR_ID, TRIM(API_KEY) AS ACCESS_KEY, TRIM(API_SECRET_KEY) AS SECRET_KEY, SEND_MAIL, USER_NEW_YN1, USER_NEW_YN2 FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER CU ON CA.USER_NO = CU.USER_NO WHERE SHOP_TYPE = '11' AND CU.USER_TYPE IN ('01','02','97') AND CA.SHOP_ID NOT IN ('ypa0940','funnyD_TEST') GROUP BY SHOP_ID, VENDOR_ID, API_KEY, API_SECRET_KEY -- 혹시 모를 중복 대비 ORDER BY USER_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_ACCOUNT SET USER_NEW_YN1 = 'N', USER_NEW_YN2 = 'N' WHERE SHOP_TYPE = '11' AND SHOP_ID = #{SHOP_ID}
